Maria: Quick heads-up — saw perf regressions when flipping a small % to flashv3 on long-context cached workloads. Need an integration plan: kernel selector logic, safe feature flags, telemetry keys, and rollback criteria. @Suresh @Elaine :eyes:

Suresh: I profiled a few slices this morning. TL;DR: flashv3 is great for short/medium sequences but regresses on very long sequences when KV hitrate is low. Key points: continuous batching + paged-KV churn causes extra memcpy and occasional spikes. Snippet from `nvprof`/custom tracer below (simplified):

```
# seq=512: flashv3  ->  tokens/sec +18% | GPU mem -12%
# seq=2048: flashv3 -> parity with fa2 (~+2%)
# seq=4096: flashv3 -> -14% p95, observed KV_evictions++ and memcpy spikes
KV_hitrate=0.27 -> more fallback/eviction work
trace: nvlink_copy ms: [0.4,0.6,4.2]  (spike on large seq + batch)
```

Suresh: Also saw OOM near edge when batch_size>2 and seq>6k on some models — likely memory fragmentation from fallback path.

Jake: Proposal for selector heuristic (lightweight):
1) if seq_len <= 1024 -> pick flashv3
2) else if seq_len <= 3072 and kv_hitrate >= 0.6 -> pick flashv3
3) else if kv_paged_enabled -> prefer paged-attn/fused fallback
4) if batch_size >= 4 prefer fused-attn when supported
Add telemetry dims: kernel_choice, seq_len_bucket, kv_hitrate, batch_size, fallback_reason.

Jake: Example runtime flag shape: `runtime.feature.attn_kernel_mode = "selector-v1"` and `runtime.selector.weights = {"flashv3":0.6, "paged":0.3, "fused":0.1}` (defaults tuned by perf team).

Elaine: Rollout plan (ops-friendly):
- Phase 0: internal canary 0.1% with synthetic long/short prompts (48h)
- Phase 1: canary 1% real traffic (72h) gated on metrics below
- Phase 2: gradual ramp to 10%/50% with automated ramping if gates OK

Elaine: Hard gates to abort:
- p95 latency regress > 10% over baseline for 2 consecutive hours
- OOM count increases > 0.5 incidents/hour
- error rate (5xx) delta > 0.1%
- cross-region variance large (we see different NV configs)

Elaine: Quick rctl example to enable selector in canary: `rctl set-flag runtime.feature.attn_kernel_mode selector-v1 --scope canary --pct 0.1`

Suresh: Ops note: we should emit a `kernel_decision_reason` tag when fallback happens (e.g., "kv_eviction", "oom_protect", "seq_threshold"). That will make postmortems way easier. Also consider a short-lived reactive cap: if KV_evictions/sec > X then temporarily lower flashv3 weight.

Maria: Good. Additions: add a small perf test to our CI that runs with kv_hitrate synthetic low/high to catch regressions in PRs. Also please add an alert in console: `attn.kernel.p95_delta > 8%` as soft-warning and `>10%` as hard abort.

Jake: I'll add the selector prototype + telemetry patch. Suresh can add profiler dashboards (kv_evictions, memcpy spikes). Elaine will draft the rollout playbook and rctl snippets.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `runtime.feature.attn_kernel_mode=selector-v1` at 0.1% (zone: us-west-2) — monitoring channels: #eng-runtime, #incidents.

Maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: Action items summarized:
- Jake: prototype selector + unit tests + flag hooks
- Suresh: dashboards + perf suites for low/high KV hitrate
- Elaine: rollout playbook + gate thresholds + rctl templates
- Ops: short-lived reactive caps and `kernel_decision_reason` telemetry

Maria: We'll reconvene after 48h of Phase 0 metrics. If anyone spots anomalies before that ping me directly.
